paras.pashto: د ماشومانو د حقونو په نړیوال کنوانسیون کې د ماشومانو پر ساتنې، بقا او سلامتۍ او نورو ټینګار شوی. د ۶.۲ مادې له مخې غړي دولتونه دې د ماشومانو بقا او پرمختګ تر شوني او لوی حده ډاډمن کړي. د سورة بني اسرائیل د ۳۱مې آیت له مخې خدايي ارشاد دی: "او خپل اولاد د فقر له وېرې مه وژنئ، موږ هغوی ته هم رزق ورکوو او تاسو ته هم. بې‌شکه د هغوی وژل لویه ګناه ده." د بوتانو په نوم د هلکانو او نجونو قرباني منع شوه او د ټولنیز شرم څخه د ژغورنې لپاره د نجونو د ژوندۍ ښخولو دود ختم شو. زوی د الله نعمت او لور رحمت ګڼل شوې. د رسول الله (صلی الله علیه وعلی آله واصحابه وسلم) ارشاد دی چې ماشومانو ته د مالي ډالیو په ورکولو کې عدالت وکړئ. که ما ته د کوم جنس لومړیتوب ورکول وای، نو د مالي ډالیو په ورکولو کې به مې نجونو ته پر هلکانو لومړیتوب ورکړی وای. له حضرت ابن عباس (رض) روایت دی چې رسول الله (صلی الله علیه وعلی آله واصحابه وسلم) وفرمایل چې چا لور درلوده او ژوندۍ یې ښخه نه کړه، سپکاوی یې ونه کړ او خپلو زامنو ته یې پرې لومړیتوب ورنه کړ، الله به یې جنت ته ننباسي.

paras.urdu: معاہدہ کے دفعہ 20 میں ایسے بچوں کا ذکر ہے جو والدین سے جدا ہوں تو اُن کی طرف خصوصی توجہ، تعلیم و تربیت اور نگرانی کے انتظامات کی تاکید کی گئی ہے۔ اِن میں یتیم بچے بھی شامل ہیں۔ قرآن میں اُنیس آیتوں میں یتیم بچوں اور بچیوں کے ساتھ سخت اور ظالمانہ سلوک کی ممانعت کی ہے۔ اِس بات کی تاکید کی گئی ہے کہ اِن بچوں کے ساتھ نرمی اور اِنصاف کا سلوک کیا جائے۔ یتیم کو دھوکہ دینے والوں کو خبردار کیا گیا ہے۔ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وعلیٰ آلہ واصحابہ وسلم خود یتیم تھے۔ یتیم کو کھلانے والے کو بشارت دی گئی ہے۔ جو یتیم کا مال کھاتے ہیں تو جہنم میں اُن کے پیٹ آگ سے بھر دیئے جائیں گے۔ اِسلام یتیم کی دولت اور ملکیت کے تحفظ پر بہت زور دیتا ہے۔ حضرت ابن عباسؓ سے روایت ہے کہ آپ صلی اللہ علیہ وعلیٰ آلہ واصحابہ وسلم نے فرمایا کہ جس نے کسی یتیم کو اپنے کھانے پینے میں ساتھ رکھا تو اللہ نے اُس کیلئے جنت لازم ٹھہرا دی سوائے اِس کے کہ کوئی ایسا گناہ کرتے جس کی بخشش نہ ہو سکے۔
paras.pashto: د تړون په ۲۰مه ماده کې د داسې ماشومانو یادونه ده چې له مور او پلار جلا وي، نو هغوی ته ځانګړې پاملرنې، زده‌کړې، روزنې او څارنې د انتظاماتو ټینګار شوی. په دوی کې یتیم ماشومان هم شامل دي. د قرآن په نولسو آیتونو کې له یتیمو هلکانو او نجونو سره سخت او ظالمانه چلند منع شوی. ټینګار شوی چې له دې ماشومانو سره نرمي او عدالت وشي. هغه کسان چې یتیم غولوي، خبرداري ورکړل شوې. رسول الله (صلی الله علیه وعلی آله واصحابه وسلم) پخپله یتیم و. هغه چا ته زېری ورکړل شوی چې یتیم ته خواړه ورکوي. څوک چې د یتیم مال خوري، په دوزخ کې به یې خېټې له اوره ډکې شي. اسلام د یتیم د شتمنۍ او ملکیت پر ساتنې ډېر ټینګار کوي. له حضرت ابن عباس (رض) روایت دی چې رسول الله (صلی الله علیه وعلی آله واصحابه وسلم) وفرمایل چې چا یو یتیم له ځان سره په خوړو او څښلو کې شریک کړ، الله به ورته جنت لازم کړي، پرته له دې چې داسې ګناه وکړي چې بښنه یې ونه شي.

This act was declared an artificial act in which there is neither a blood relationship between the child and the parents nor a real emotional relationship. Children should be called by the name of their real parents.

Protection, survival and safety:

In the world convention on children’s rights, emphasis has been placed on the protection, survival and safety of children. According to Article 6.2, party states shall ensure the survival and development of children to the extent possible. According to verse 31 of Surah Bani Israel the divine command is: “And do not kill your children for fear of poverty; We give provision to them and to you too. Surely killing them is a great sin.” The sacrifice of boys and girls in the name of idols was prohibited, and the custom of burying girls alive to save them from social disgrace was ended. The son has been declared a blessing of Allah and the daughter a mercy. The saying of the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) is that in giving monetary gifts to children act with justice. If I were to give preference to any sex, I would give preference to girls in giving monetary gifts. It is narrated from Hazrat Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them) that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) said that whoever has a daughter and does not bury her alive, nor insults her, and does not give preference to his sons over her, Allah will admit him into Paradise.

Orphan children:

In Article 20 of the convention there is mention of such children who are separated from parents; special attention, education, training and supervision arrangements have been urged for them. Orphan children are also included among these. In nineteen verses of the Quran, harsh and cruel behaviour with orphan boys and girls has been prohibited. It has been stressed that gentleness and justice be shown to these children. Those who deceive orphans have been warned. The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) himself was an orphan. Those who feed the orphan have been given glad tidings. Those who eat up the property of orphans fill their bellies with fire. Islam lays great stress on the protection of the wealth and property of orphans. It is narrated from Hazrat Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them) that the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) said that whoever kept an orphan with him in eating and drinking, Allah makes Paradise obligatory for him, except that he commits such a sin as cannot be forgiven.

paras.text: In the world convention on children’s rights there are many such things which are not mentioned in Islam, but Islam has not prohibited them either, rather it has indirectly encouraged those things. For example, because the parties to the convention are states, therefore in this convention more responsibilities have been placed on states, while in Islam the responsibilities of parents are more and the responsibilities of the state not as much. In the convention the rights of parents are mentioned in connection with children’s rights, and states have been directed to ensure such rights of parents as are important for children. However in Islam emphasis has been placed on the respect of children for the rights of parents. In the convention, with regard to children, state legislation has been declared a central point, whereas in Islam there is no special mention of such legislation. The talk of keeping children away from war and not recruiting them into the army has been made. In Islam children took practical part in jihad in the battle of Badr, but when the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) issued the order for an Islamic army, he gave instructions to save the old, women, crops, animals and children from war. According to Article 15 of the convention, children have the rights of freedom of organisation and peaceful assemblies. According to Article 17 states will have to recognise the importance of the mass media for children. Making it possible for children to obtain information through the media which is necessary for their durable and healthy development; the media should keep in view the understanding and language of children. Although in Islam these rights are not stated directly, they have not been prohibited either, and today’s Islamic state can implement these rights.

Physical and moral training:

In the convention emphasis has been placed on ensuring the physical and moral protection of children. Children should be saved from such an environment where there are possibilities of their physical and moral corruption.

In the world convention on children’s rights there are many such things which are not mentioned in Islam, but Islam has not prohibited them either, rather it has indirectly encouraged those things. For example, because the parties to the convention are states, therefore in this convention more responsibilities have been placed on states, while in Islam the responsibilities of parents are more and the responsibilities of the state not as much. In the convention the rights of parents are mentioned in connection with children’s rights, and states have been directed to ensure such rights of parents as are important for children. However in Islam emphasis has been placed on the respect of children for the rights of parents. In the convention, with regard to children, state legislation has been declared a central point, whereas in Islam there is no special mention of such legislation. The talk of keeping children away from war and not recruiting them into the army has been made. In Islam children took practical part in jihad in the battle of Badr, but when the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, his family and companions) issued the order for an Islamic army, he gave instructions to save the old, women, crops, animals and children from war. According to Article 15 of the convention, children have the rights of freedom of organisation and peaceful assemblies. According to Article 17 states will have to recognise the importance of the mass media for children. Making it possible for children to obtain information through the media which is necessary for their durable and healthy development; the media should keep in view the understanding and language of children. Although in Islam these rights are not stated directly, they have not been prohibited either, and today’s Islamic state can implement these rights.

Women Rights

Women are half the population of the world. Today in the world the matter of their rights is under heated discussion. According to the Oxford Dictionary, women’s rights are those rights which promote the state of social and legal equality between women and men.
